sections.lede: Health care economics, medical economics and managerial economics, from Manchester and London to Louisiana and Florida.

groups.label: Florida · 1987–1998
names: Professor of Economics, Graduate Business School, Florida Institute of Technology, Treasure Coast Graduate Center, Stuart. Graduate courses in health care economics, managerial economics and advanced macro- and microeconomics
Professor of Economics, Rinker School of Business, Palm Beach Atlantic College, West Palm Beach. Microeconomics, macroeconomics, the free enterprise system and international economics

groups.label: Louisiana · 1977–1987
names: Associate Professor, College of Business Administration, University of Southwestern Louisiana, Lafayette — 1980–1987. Undergraduate and graduate courses in economics, finance and management
Associate Professor, Department of Medicine, LSU Medical Center, New Orleans — 1978–1980. Lectures in medical economics at the medical school, and computer-assisted data analysis for drug research
Assistant Professor, Department of Economics and Management, University of New Orleans — 1977–1978. Courses in economics and health care

groups.label: England · 1974–1977
names: Research Associate, University of Manchester — 1975–1977. Lecturer in economics and course coordinator of the administrative development course for hospital administrators
Research Fellow, Centre for Studies in Social Policy, London — 1974–1975. Case study of the Wigan Community Health Council, published in 1976

groups.label: Forensic and business economics
names: Referee, Journal of Forensic Economics — two years
National Association of Forensic Economists — member since 1989
American Academy of Economic and Financial Experts — member since 1989
National Association for Business Economics, Health Roundtable — member since 1990
American Economic Association — member since 1983

groups.label: Health economics and settlements
names: American Society of Health Economists — member since 2008
Health Economics Study Group, Great Britain — member since 1973
Society for Benefit-Cost Analysis — 2023
National Structured Settlements Trade Association — associate member
Licensed in health and life insurance — Florida and Louisiana
